INSERT INTO programme (
                authored_at, template, primary_pattern, primary_exercise,
                anchor_grams, anchor_provenance, anchor_from, anchor_failed_grams,
                opening_grams, gating_role, start_date, duration_weeks
            )
            VALUES (?, 'linear', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            RETURNING id
